briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Stripe, 17 November 2026

**Scope:** Changes in the 30 days before the meeting, based only on the search results provided. Coverage is thin: the results are mostly from 4–13 November 2026, and I found no sources on hires or new deals in that window.

## What changed

**Launches**
- Stripe now lets US businesses send stablecoin payments directly to crypto wallets in more than 160 markets. The capability is part of Global Payouts and launched in public preview in early November 2026. (https://cryptonews.net/news/market/33703716)

**Partnerships and integrations**
- Celo's MiniPay wallet (more than 20 million wallets) was scheduled to integrate Link by Stripe on 12 November 2026, giving EU and US users one-click fiat-to-stablecoin purchases. The source describes this as scheduled, so I could not confirm it went live. (https://www.tradingview.com/news/coinmarketcal:ce753058b094b:0-celo-minipay-integrates-link-by-stripe-for-one-click-stablecoin-purchases-12-nov-2026)
- Anthropic's Enterprise Frontier Safeguards is in private beta with customers including Stripe, per an Anthropic announcement dated 10 November 2026. (https://www.anthropic.com/claude-fable-and-mythos-5-2)

**Deals (outside the 30-day window)**
- A Stripe company profile lists acquisitions of OpenRouter, Inc. (1 August 2026, 7.50B USD), Clerky, Inc. (1 August 2026), and Valora, Inc. (1 December 2025). These fall outside the window, and the profile is undated. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/igPwhNOUwEGy)

**Hires:** No sources found.

**Industry context (not Stripe-specific)**
- A WSJ report from 13 November 2026 says AI assistants, including Meta's, have recently been enabled to make purchases on cardholders' behalf, and that banks are racing to respond. The article, as excerpted, does not mention Stripe. (https://www.wsj.com/finance/ai-bots-are-using-credit-cards-banks-are-racing-to-keep-up-c30dda30)

## Open questions

1. Which markets and customer segments are in the stablecoin payouts public preview, and when is general availability expected?
2. Has the Celo MiniPay / Link integration gone live, and what volume or adoption are you seeing so far?
3. How does the OpenRouter acquisition fit into your AI and agent-payments roadmap, and how will it affect existing Stripe customers?
